current.text: Moussa Diabaté is the projected starting center in Charlotte. Kalkbrenner competes for center minutes with Diabaté, Steinbach, Kai Jones and the rookie taken 14th. Grant Williams also plays some small-ball five.
Charlotte played better last season with Diabaté starting at center.
He is expected to be last in Charlotte's center rotation and to be out of the rotation on many nights. The expert says not to count on him.
Charlotte has only 13 back-to-backs, the league minimum. With a March 28 end, the team plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks.

durable.text: He blocks shots well and is the best rim protector among Charlotte's bigs. In Summer League he blocked 3.7 shots in 27 minutes.
Outside of blocks and rebounds he adds little. He looked slow and scored only 5 points per game in Summer League.
He takes no threes. Charlotte does not let him shoot from the perimeter.
He was very efficient as a starter. His FG% is very high, but on low volume.

note: At 0 USD on both sites, rank 246 on Yahoo and 182 on ESPN, he sits well outside our 144-player draft pool. Do not draft him. His only fantasy appeal is blocks and FG% on low volume, which makes him a limited fit for punt 3PM and punt STL builds. Early in the season, watch Charlotte's center minutes. He is worth a waiver pickup only if injuries to Diabaté or the other bigs push him into a regular role.
